t40: The difference between elimination mode and regular picking
t41: In regular mode, all names are in the pool each draw; the same person can come up multiple times in a row. In elimination mode, the drawn name is removed from the pool, so no one comes out again until everyone has been selected once.
t42: If you're looking for a single winner, regular mode is the right tool; if you're building an order, elimination mode is.
t44: Using team selector instead of drawing names one by one and manually writing teams both saves time and divides teams evenly. When you set the team count, the app distributes names equally; if there are extra players, it spreads the overflow between teams.
t45: More than 15 tools in one app
t46: Quick Raffle combines name picker, number draw, spinner, bag, team selector, dice, coin flip, card draw, list shuffle, bingo, yes/no, Secret Santa, tournament bracket, and password generator in one app. All work offline and results are generated fairly.
t48: Can the same name come out twice?
t49: In regular mode yes, because all names are in the pool each draw. If you don't want repeats, use elimination mode; the drawn name is removed from the pool.
t50: How do I divide teams equally?
t51: Just enter names in team selector and specify the team count. If the player count doesn't divide evenly, extra people are distributed evenly to teams.
